```{r}
library(Nebulosa)
library(viridis)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)

plot_a_list <- function(master_list_with_plots, no_of_rows, no_of_cols) {
  
  patchwork::wrap_plots(master_list_with_plots, 
                        nrow = no_of_rows, ncol = no_of_cols)
}

seurat.merge <- readRDS("./data/seurat.merged.rds")
```




# General Marker Graphs

```{r}
B.cells <- c("CD79A", "CD79B", "MS4A1", "CD19")
DCs <- c("CLEC4A", "ITGAX", "ITGAM", "ITGAE", "FLT3", "CLEC4C", "THBD", "CD1C") 
Gran <- c("FCGR3", "GR1", "ITGAM", "CCRL2")  #replace FCGR3 and GR1
T.cells <- c("CD3D", "CD4", "CD8A", "CCR7", "SELL", "FOXP3", "IL2RA", "CXCR5", "ICOS", "CTLA4", "PDCD1", "LAG3")
NK.cells <- c("NKG7", "EOMES", "KLRC1", "KLRK1")
MO <- c("CD68", "ITGAM", "FCGR3A", "FCGR3B", "CD14", "CD163", "CSF1R", "ADGRE1")

cell.list <- list(B.cells, DCs, Gran, T.cells, NK.cells, MO)
names(cell.list) <- c("B.cells", "DCs", "Gran", "T.cells", "NK.cells", "MO")

DefaultAssay(seurat.merge) <- "SCT"
for(i in seq_along(cell.list)) {
  tmp.plot <- FeaturePlot(seurat.merge, 
                          raster = FALSE,
                features = cell.list[[i]],
              cols = viridis_pal(option = "B")(11), 
              combine = FALSE) 

    for(x in seq_along(tmp.plot)) {
      tmp.plot[[x]] <- tmp.plot[[x]] + 
        guides(color = "none") + 
        theme_void() 
        #theme(plot.title = element_blank())
    }
  ndim <- length(cell.list[[i]])
  if(ndim %% 4 == 0) {
    rows <- round(ndim /4)
  } else {
    if (ndim %% 4 %in% c(1)) {
      rows <- round(ndim /4) + 1
    } else {
      rows <- round(ndim /4)
    }
  }

  plot_a_list(tmp.plot, rows,4)
  ggsave(paste0("./output/", names(cell.list)[i], ".markers.png"), height = 3*rows, width = 12, dpi = 600, bg = "transparent")
}

```

```{r}
Idents(seurat.merge) <- "snn.leiden"
all.markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat.merge, 
                              test.use = "MAST", 
                              latent.vars = "orig.ident")
write.csv(all.markers, "./output/all.markers.csv")

top.markers <- all.markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(n = 5, order_by = avg_log2FC)
```



```{r}
table <- data.frame(prop.table(table(seurat.merge$cloneType, seurat.merge$snn.leiden, useNA = "ifany"), margin = 2))
ggplot(table, aes(x=Var2, y = Freq, fill = Var1)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") + 
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "H", discrete = TRUE, na.value = "grey")
```
```{r}
cells.to.remove <- unique(c(which(nchar(stringr::str_split(seurat.merge$CTaa, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1]) > 50), #TRA chain > 50 aa
                     which(nchar(stringr::str_split(seurat.merge$CTaa, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,2]) > 50), 
                     grep(";",seurat.merge$CTaa))) #multichains

cells <- rownames(seurat.merge[[]])
cells <- cells[-cells.to.remove]
seurat.merge <- subset(seurat.merge, cells = cells)

features <- read.csv("variable.features.csv")
VariableFeatures(seurat.merge) <- features$x
seurat.merge <- RunPCA(seurat.merge)

library(Trex)
conga <- CoNGAfy(seurat.merge,
                 meta.carry = c("CTaa", "CTgene"))

conga <- runTrex(conga, 
                    AA.properties = "KF", 
                    reduction.name = "Trex.KF")
saveRDS(conga, "./data/conga.rds")
```
